get.summary: Service health
get.description: Checks database, cache and broker connectivity.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get my profile
get.description: Any logged-in user (users.profile.read_own). Returns ETag.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to edit my first and last name
patch.description: Any logged-in user (users.profile.update_own). Only first_name and last_name can change; email, role and status cannot. If-Match is optional.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list roles
get.description: Admin only (users.user.invite). The two roles for the Invite User form. Not paginated.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list users
get.description: Admin only (users.user.read_all). Search by name or email; filter by status and role; sort by first_name, email or created_at. 20 per page by default.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get one user
get.description: Admin only (users.user.read_all). Returns ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304 when unchanged.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to activate or deactivate a user
patch.description: Admin only (users.user.update_status). Requires If-Match. INACTIVE logs the user out on their next request and stops new Todos; ACTIVE (from INACTIVE) resumes Todos from today. An Admin cannot change their own status; an INVITED user becomes ACTIVE only by accepting the invitation.

delete.summary: Purpose of this API is to delete a user permanently
delete.description: Admin only (users.user.delete). Requires If-Match. Hard delete: the user and all their assignments, Todos, history and tokens are removed and disappear from past reports. An Admin cannot delete their own account. Call GET /v1/users/{user_id}/delete-preview first to show the impact.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to log in
post.description: Public. Email + password. Returns an access token (1 hour) and a refresh token (7 days). Wrong email, wrong password and not-yet-accepted invitations all give 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS. An inactive account gives 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE. Rate limited.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is OAuth2 login for Swagger
post.description: Public. Form fields `username` (email) and `password`. Used by Swagger's Authorize button. Returns the OAuth2 format {access_token, token_type} (documented exception to the response envelope).

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to renew tokens
post.description: Public (refresh token in the body). Rotation: the old refresh token stops working and a new pair is returned. Reusing an old refresh token logs the user out everywhere (401 TOKEN_REUSED).

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to log out this device
post.description: Logged-in user. Revokes the given refresh token. Idempotent.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get my permissions
get.description: Any logged-in user (users.profile.read_own). The role and permission codes, used by the frontend to show or hide menu items and buttons.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to change my password
patch.description: Any logged-in user (users.profile.update_own). Requires the current password. This device (given refresh_token) stays logged in; all others are logged out.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to invite a user
post.description: Admin only (users.user.invite). Creates the user as INVITED and emails a link valid for 24 hours (sent in the background). Email must be unique (409 DUPLICATE_EMAIL).

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to check an invitation link
post.description: Public. Returns the invitee's name and email, or 422 LINK_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to accept an invitation
post.description: Public. Sets the password (8-16 characters, a letter and a digit) and activates the account. The link works once.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to re-send an invitation
post.description: Admin only (users.user.invite). The previous link stops working; a new one (24 hours) is emailed. Only for INVITED users.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to request a password reset link
post.description: Public. Always returns 202 with the same message, whether or not the email exists. The link is valid for 1 hour. Rate limited.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to send a change-password link
post.description: Admin only (users.user.send_password_link). For ACTIVE users. Link valid for 1 hour.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to check a password reset link
post.description: Public. Returns the email, or 422 LINK_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to set a new password from a link
post.description: Public. Works once. Logs the user out on every device.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list task types and their answers
get.description: Any logged-in user (assignments.todo.read_own). The four types (Time, Yes-No, Food, Number) with the answers users can give. Number also accepts Other (a whole number of 5 or more).

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to create a task
post.description: Admin only (activities.task.create). New tasks are ACTIVE. Name is unique (ignoring case, 409 DUPLICATE_TASK_NAME). The type can't be changed later.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list tasks
get.description: Admin only (activities.task.read_all). Search by name; filter by type and status; sort by name or updated_at. 20 per page by default.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get one task
get.description: Admin only (activities.task.read_all). Returns ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to edit, activate or deactivate a task
patch.description: Admin only (activities.task.update). Requires If-Match. Name and description can change (renaming applies to past history too); the type can't (422 FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE). INACTIVE stops new Todos from tomorrow; pending Todos stay answerable. ACTIVE (from INACTIVE) creates today's Todos where due, in the background; missed days are not filled in.

delete.summary: Purpose of this API is to delete a task permanently
delete.description: Admin only (activities.task.delete). Requires If-Match. Hard delete: the task, all its assignments and all its Todos for every user are removed, and past reports change. Call GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}/delete-preview first to show the impact.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to assign a task to users
post.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.create). Send `user_ids` or `all_users=true` (every ACTIVE user now). Users who already have the task are skipped and listed. Start date defaults to today and must be today or later; weekdays are required for WEEKLY. If due today, today's Todo is created now.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list assignments
get.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.read_all). Filter by user, task, frequency and status (ACTIVE by default, ENDED, ALL); sort by user_name, task_name, start_date or created_at.

post.summary: Purpose of this API is to copy a user's assignments to other users
post.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.copy). Copies the source's active assignments (active tasks, not past their end date) with the same frequency, weekdays, start and end dates. Tasks a target already has are skipped. `dry_run=true` returns the preview without changing anything.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to preview the next due dates of a schedule
get.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.create). Helper for the Assign / Change Frequency forms. `weekdays` is comma-separated, e.g. MON,THU.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get one assignment
get.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.read_all). Includes the next 3 due dates. Returns ETag.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to change frequency, change end date, or de-assign
patch.description: Admin only (assignments.assignment.update). Requires If-Match. One change per request: (1) `frequency` (+ `weekdays`, optional `start_date`): pending Todos from today on are replaced; completed and past pending Todos stay. (2) `end_date` (null removes it): set, extend or shorten; extending an assignment that ended by its end date makes it active again. (3) `status: ENDED`: de-assign; today's and past pending Todos stay answerable. A de-assigned assignment can't be changed (assign again instead).

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list my pending Todos for a date
get.description: Any logged-in user (assignments.todo.read_own). Pending Todos only (answered ones are in history), for `date` (default today, IST; past dates allowed). Filter by frequency, search by task name.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get my pending-dates calendar
get.description: Any logged-in user (assignments.todo.read_own). Dates of `month` (YYYY-MM, default current) that have pending Todos, with counts. Includes the server's `today`.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get my dashboard counts
get.description: Any logged-in user (assignments.todo.read_own). Pending Todos due on `date` (default today), per frequency (all seven). Includes the server's `today`.

patch.summary: Purpose of this API is to answer a Todo
patch.description: Any logged-in user, own Todos only (assignments.todo.respond_own). The answer must suit the task type (Time HH:MM; Yes/No; Food; Number 1-4 or No, or `is_other` with a whole number of 5 or more). Any answer, including No, completes the Todo. Answers can't be changed (409). If-Match optional.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list my completed Todos
get.description: Any logged-in user (assignments.history.read_own). Default range: the current week (Mon-Sun); at most one year. Filter by task and frequency. Newest due date first.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to list completed Todos of all users
get.description: Admin only (assignments.history.read_all). Same as my history, plus a `user_id` filter; each item includes the user.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to preview what deleting a user removes
get.description: Admin only (users.user.delete). Counts of assignments, Todos and completed Todos. Deletes nothing. All zero for an invited user.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to preview what deleting a task removes
get.description: Admin only (activities.task.delete). Users affected, assignments, Todos and completed Todos. Deletes nothing.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get the report for all users or one user
get.description: Admin only (reporting.report.read_all). Range: `range_type` DAY (default, today; or `day`), WEEK (Mon-Sun; `week_start` must be a Monday), MONTH (`month` YYYY-MM), CUSTOM (`date_from` + `date_to`, at most one year). Per frequency (all seven): total, completed (includes No), no, pending, status (NO_TASK if total is 0, PENDING if anything is pending, otherwise COMPLETE). A Todo counts on its due date. `summary` covers all selected users; `users` is paginated (20 per page, by name) and includes inactive users (marked) and users with no Todos (all NO_TASK). No export.

get.summary: Purpose of this API is to get my report
get.description: Any logged-in user (reporting.report.read_own). Range: `range_type` DAY (default, today; or `day`), WEEK (Mon-Sun; `week_start` must be a Monday), MONTH (`month` YYYY-MM), CUSTOM (`date_from` + `date_to`, at most one year). Per frequency (all seven): total, completed (includes No), no, pending, status (NO_TASK if total is 0, PENDING if anything is pending, otherwise COMPLETE). A Todo counts on its due date.

AssignmentCreate.title: AssignmentCreate
AssignmentCreate.description: POST /v1/assignments — one task to one, several or all ACTIVE users (ASG-R1–R6).

AssignmentUpdate.title: AssignmentUpdate
AssignmentUpdate.description:
PATCH /v1/assignments/{assignment_id} — exactly one change type per request:

- change frequency: `frequency` (+ `weekdays`), optional `start_date` (default today)
- change end date: `end_date` (null removes it)
- de-assign: `status` = "ENDED"

ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo
ErrorInfo.description: Only `code` and `details`; `message` lives at the root.

FrequencyCounts.title: FrequencyCounts
FrequencyCounts.description: T, C, N, P, S for one frequency. Always total = completed + pending; `no` is part of `completed`.

LinkTokenRequest.title: LinkTokenRequest
LinkTokenRequest.description: Verify an invitation or reset link. The token travels in the body, never in the URL.

OAuth2TokenRead.title: OAuth2TokenRead
OAuth2TokenRead.description: POST /v1/auth/token — OAuth2 format for Swagger (documented exception to the envelope).

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description: PATCH /v1/me — first and last name only (USR-R2).

ReportRead.title: ReportRead
ReportRead.description:
GET /v1/reports — summary over ALL selected users, plus a paginated list of user rows
(documented variation of Rule 5: the pagination fields sit inside `users`).

RoleListRead.title: RoleListRead
RoleListRead.description: GET /v1/roles — fixed list of two, not paginated.

TaskUpdate.title: TaskUpdate
TaskUpdate.description: PATCH /v1/tasks/{task_id}. `type` is accepted only to answer 422 FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE (ACT-R3).

TodoAnswer.title: TodoAnswer
TodoAnswer.description: PATCH /v1/me/todos/{todo_id} — the answer is validated against the task type (ASG-R22).
